eligibility: error is null; visual_geometry_count>0; exactly one bounded non-degenerate primary joint of type revolute or prismatic; primary_joint.zero_relation is lower or upper
selection: Sort all eligible rows by SHA256('node7.1-object-selection-v1|'+source+'|'+object_id), select first 36. This extends the already-frozen node7.1 prefix, so an existing profiled object is included iff it belongs to that same first-36 prefix; profile availability is never consulted.

split.rank: Sort selected 36 by SHA256(raw_sealed_salt || '|node7.2-split-rank-v1|' || source || '|' || object_id)

conformal.score: maximum absolute normalized two-endpoint distance residual per object

service.method_submission: frozen source commit, exact config, and one from-scratch head-training request
service.executor_visibility: public profile schema and non-target provenance only; no presentation bit, canonical side, limits, fractions, raw target, calibration target, confirmatory target, salt, rank, or score
service.training: evaluator trains once on the sealed 18-object train partition using the preregistered loss and returns only a model hash/receipt
service.calibration: evaluator computes the fixed conformal radius on nine sealed calibration objects after the head is frozen
service.confirmatory: evaluator scores nine sealed confirmatory objects once; no retry, checkpoint choice, seed choice, threshold choice, or result selection
service.outputs: aggregate preregistered metrics, coverage and provenance receipt only; no per-object targets

protected: all score files before split freeze
authorization_condition: A separate independent receipt must materialize and hash all 36 public profiles plus a sealed split manifest that exactly implements this preregistration.
